I'll search for information about this Georgia Department of Revenue Motor Vehicle Division webpage.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>site:mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx Georgia vehicle tags registration</query>

Based on my search, I can provide information about this webpage. The URL `https://mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx` is the official **Georgia Department of Revenue - Motor Vehicle Division (MVD) Tags and Titles page**.

## What This Page Contains

This is Georgia's official online portal for motor vehicle tag (license plate) and title services. The page provides access to:

- **Vehicle Registration Renewal** - Renew your Georgia license plate registration online
- **Title Services** - Apply for or replace vehicle titles
- **Tag Information** - Various tag types and specialty plates available in Georgia
- **Forms and Documents** - Required paperwork for vehicle transactions
- **Fee Information** - Costs associated with tags, titles, and registration

## Key Services Available

| Service | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Online Registration Renewal | Renew your vehicle registration without visiting an office |
| Title Applications | Apply for a new or replacement title |
| Specialty/Personalized Plates | Order custom or specialty license plates |
| Registration Status Check | Verify your registration status |
| Fee Calculators | Estimate costs for various services |

## How to Access

The direct URL is: **https://mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx**

You can also reach this page through the main Georgia DOR website at dor.georgia.gov by navigating to the Motor Vehicle Division section.

## Important Notes

- Georgia residents must renew vehicle registration annually
- The state requires valid auto insurance to register or renew tags
- Certain transactions may still require in-person visits to County Tag Offices
- Online services typically accept credit/debit cards with convenience fees

Would you like more specific information about any particular tag or title service in Georgia?

---

Sources:
1. https://mvd.dor.ga.gov/tags/index.aspx
2. https://dor.georgia.gov/motor-vehicles
